soal_02_stimulus_01.png.description: Graph with the vertical axis labeled "P" and the horizontal axis labeled "Q". Printed labels on the P axis: "Rp25.000,00" (upper) and "Rp20.000,00" (lower). Printed labels on the Q axis: "1.000" and "1.500". Three straight lines: an unlabeled downward-sloping line from the upper left to the lower right; an upward-sloping line labeled "S" (label at its upper end); and a second upward-sloping line labeled "S1" (label at its upper end), located to the right of S. Line S crosses the downward-sloping line at a point from which a thin gray dashed horizontal line runs left to "Rp25.000,00" and a thin gray dashed vertical line runs down to the Q axis at "1.000". Line S1 crosses the downward-sloping line at a point from which a bold black dashed horizontal line runs left to "Rp20.000,00" and a bold black dashed vertical line runs down to the Q axis at "1.500".
